Container.Name: M3m0s
Container.Overview: Long-term memory for LLM agents: MCP, CLI and an embedded WebUI over one local database. Tool-agnostic, so Claude Code, pi, opencode, Hermes and Open WebUI can read and write the same memory.
Container.Changes: Dropped the legacy Networking/Data/Environment blocks (they duplicate the Config entries and broke a recreate on 17/nov); M3M0S_DATA_DIR moved into a Config entry, because the image default is ~/.m3m0s/data. Initial template. Image 0.8.1.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: memory ai agent mcp rag embeddings llm claude
Container.Description:
M3m0s is a long-term memory service for LLM agents. One instance holds the memory, and every client talks to it over the authenticated HTTP API, the MCP endpoint or the CLI.
### First start
1. Open the WebUI and create the first account right away. The setup page needs no API key, so anyone who reaches the instance first can claim it. Do not expose the port before finishing this step. 2. The first start also prints a generated API key in the container log. Copy it, because it is shown only once. Use it as `M3M0S_API_KEY` in the clients.
### Embeddings
`OPENAI_API_KEY` is optional. Without it the server still runs, but in keyword-only mode: search uses full-text (FTS5) and deduplication is exact-match only. Set the key to enable vector search.
### Clients
- Remote MCP: `http://<server>:19234/mcp` with the header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. - CLI and stdio MCP bridge: install `m3m0s` from the project and set `M3M0S_URL` and `M3M0S_API_KEY`. - Hook integrations for Claude Code, pi, opencode and Hermes are in the project repository.
### Container notes
- The container runs as `nobody:users` (99:100) so it can write to appdata. The image does not support PUID/PGID yet. - The database and API keys live in `/data`. Point it at a cache or array path that you back up; the directory must be writable by the container. - No database is shipped with the image. A fresh instance starts empty. - Project documentation: https://github.com/rafaelvieiras/m3m0s

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the WebUI, the REST API and the MCP endpoint.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Where the index, the API keys and the self-documentation cache live. Must stay inside the /data mount.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, index and API keys. Keep it on a path you back up.

Config.Name: OpenAI API key
Config.Description: Used for embeddings. Empty: keyword-only mode (FTS5 search, exact-match dedup).

Config.Name: OpenAI base URL
Config.Description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint. Empty: api.openai.com.

Config.Name: Extraction API key
Config.Description: Enables LLM fact extraction. Empty: each memory_add stores one raw entry.

Config.Name: Extraction base URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for extraction. Empty: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

Config.Name: Extraction model
Config.Description: Model used for fact extraction. Empty: the built-in default.

Config.Name: Chat API key
Config.Description: Enables the WebUI chat. Empty: falls back to the extraction key.

Config.Name: MCP read-only
Config.Description: 1 hides and rejects the MCP write tools, so agents can only read memory.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone used for logs and scheduled jobs.
